name: Machinify
desc:
Claims Administrator | $24.00/hr | Data Entry and Document Review Heavy, Minimal Phone 
https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/machinifyinc/jobs/4223221009

Industry: Healthcare | Billing & Admin
 What Your Day Will Look Like:
The ideal candidate demonstrates strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic environment.

 Machinify is a healthcare technology company that works with health plans across the country to manage and audit claims payments. This role sits on the Complex Payment Solutions team and supports the actual processing pipeline that claims move through before, during, and after they are reviewed.
 Key responsibilities from the posting:
Review incoming claims, assign statuses, organize data, and route files to auditors
Manage the import queue, reconcile balances, validate charges, and correct errors
Oversee file intake and output, responding to inquiries and resolving discrepancies
Analyze data trends and communicate updates on claims routing, efficiency, and volume
Monitor file-sharing processes and verify data transfer accuracy
Perform data entry and other administrative tasks as needed
This is back-office, document-heavy work. You are organizing, tracking, and routing claims files accurately so the auditors downstream have clean, correct information to work with. Multi-monitor setups and juggling several systems at once are part of daily reality here.
assessment: No formal pre-application assessment confirmed for this specific role.

notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 The process typically begins with an initial phone interview covering your background and experience. Additional interview rounds may follow depending on the team and hiring needs. The full process from application to offer generally takes a few weeks.
Likely interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you had to manage a high volume of detailed work under a deadline.
How do you stay organized when tracking multiple files or claims across different stages?
Describe your experience with Microsoft Office or Adobe Acrobat in a previous role.
How do you handle a situation where you find a discrepancy or error in someone else's work?
other:
Medical terminology and medical record review experience are listed as preferred, not required, which makes this more accessible to participants without a clinical background as long as they bring strong organizational and data accuracy skills.
